Bhikkhuno.g: bhikkhuṁ amūlakena antimavatthunā anuddhaṁsentassa bhikkhuno saṁghādisesoti attho.
puthujjanakalyāṇakassa vā bhikkhuno, sekkhassa vā bhikkhunoti patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno.
puthujjanakalyāṇakassa vā bhikkhuno, sekkhassa vā bhikkhunoti pahitattassa bhikkhuno.

bhikkhuno.l: Siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāyā
bhikkhuno.g: siyā paccayo, siyā karaṇīyaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Idañca kāsāvaṁ attano santakaṁ katvā etasseva bhikkhuno dehī
bhikkhuno.g: kiṁkāraṇā evamāha? Cīvarasāmikena yasmā dhuranikkhepo kato, tasmā tassa adinnaṁ gahetuṁ na vaṭṭati.
gāthā sukhatthaṁ rassaṁ katvā vuttaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo senaṁ gamanāyā
bhikkhuno.g: siyā paccayo siyā karaṇīyaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Na taṁ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṁ anubhotī
bhikkhuno.g: taṁ cīvaracetāpannaṁ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci appamattakampi kammaṁ na nipphādeti.
evaṁ laddhasammutiko bhikkhu yāva rogo na vūpasamati, tāva yaṁ yaṁ ṭhānaṁ gacchati, tattha tattha santhataṁ kātuṁ labhati.
avippaṭisāramūlakānaṁ pāmojjādīnaṁ vasena tassa bhikkhuno sukhā paṭipadā sampajjatīti attho.
tasmiṁ bhikkhusmiṁ nikkhante.

bhikkhuno.l: Attano santakaṁ katvā etasseva bhikkhuno dehī
bhikkhuno.g: idaṁ ubhinnampi kukkuccavinodanatthaṁ vuttaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Na taṁ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṁ anubhotī
bhikkhuno.g: taṁ cetāpannaṁ tassa bhikkhuno appamattakampi kammaṁ na nipphādeti.
vuttattā yassa adhikaraṇaṁ saṁghakammena nihataṁ, tassa sammukhe eva ukkoṭentassa pācittiyaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Tīsu ṭhānesu bhikkhuno natthi vassacchede āpattī
bhikkhuno.g: “tehi saddhiṁ gacchantasseva natthi, virujjhitvā1 gamane āpatti ca, pavāretuñca na labhatī”ti likhitaṁ, tasmā yaṁ vuttaṁ aṭṭhakathāyaṁ “atha sattho antovasseyeva bhikkhunā patthitaṭṭhānaṁ patvā atikkamati -pa- antarā ekasmiṁ gāme tiṭṭhati vā vippakirati vā”ti-ādi, taṁ ettāvatā virujjhitvā gatānampi virujjhitvā2 gamanaṁ na hoti, tasmā pavāretabbanti dassanatthanti veditabbaṁ.
yassa vinā santhatā na phāsu hoti, na sakkoti ca santhataṁ ādāya pakkamituṁ, evaṁbhūtassa gilānassa bhikkhuno.
Ettha ca “idaṁ me bhante cīvaraṁ pubbe appavāritena aññātakassa gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvarevikappaṁ āpannaṁ nissaggiyan”ti1 iminā nayena nissajjanavidhānaṁ veditabbaṁ.
Asamādānacāraṁ hi atthatakathinā eva labhanti, netareti ettha idampi kāraṇaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.
yassa taṁ bhāsati, tassa bhikkhuno “evamahaṁ etassa piyo bhavissāmī”ti attano piyabhāvaṁ patthayamānatāya.

bhikkhuno.l: Nāgoti kho bhikkhu khīṇāsavassetaṁ bhikkhuno adhivacanan
bhikkhuno.g: ettha yenatthena khīṇāsavo nāgoti vuccati, so Anaṅgaṇasutte2 pakāsito eva.
kiñcāpi aniyametvā vuttaṁ, yathā pana Jīvakasutte ca caṅkīsutte ca, evaṁ imasmiṁ sutte ca attānameva sandhāyetaṁ Bhagavatā vuttanti veditabbaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo
bhikkhuno.g: yattha ārammaṇe bhikkhuno āghāto uppanno hoti, tattha so sabbo imehi pañcahi paṭivinodetabboti attho.

bhikkhuno.l: Etāni yassa dvārāni, aguttāni ca bhikkhuno
bhikkhuno.g: yassa bhikkhuno etāni manacchaṭṭhāni dvārāni sativossaggena pamādaṁ āpannattā satikavāṭena apihitāni.
Tattha jāgariyānuyoge satisampajaññasamādānāni sabbatthakāni sammodapasādāvahāni, tattha kālavipassanā nāma vipassanāya gabbhaggahaṇaṁ paripākagataṁ.
Tattha abhijjhāyati etāyāti abhijjhā, parabhaṇḍābhijjhāyanalakkhaṇassa lobhassetaṁ adhivacanaṁ.

bhikkhuno.l: Bhikkhunoti puthujjanakalyāṇakassa vā bhikkhuno, sekkhassa vā bhikkhuno
bhikkhuno.g: bhikkhusaddassa vacanatthaṁ avatvā idhādhippetabhikkhuyeva dassito.
